{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the [[Force power/Legends|power]] to sense through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]|the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] teaching of [[Sense]] as an aspect|linebreak=1}}
[[File:Force_Sense_TPM.png|thumb|right|275px|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] sense [[Radiant VII/Legends|their ship]] being destroyed.]]
{{Quote|I felt a great disturbance in the Force&hellip; as if millions of voices suddenly cried out in terror and were suddenly silenced.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Force sense''' was among the most basic of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|abilities]]. It could be used to feel another being's feelings, the future, ripples in the Force caused by momentous or traumatic events, impending danger and the presence of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] or [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. A more concentrated, more directed form of this ability was likely how [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Miraluka/Legends|Miralukas]] were able to [[Force sight|see]] others without relying on their physical senses. Closely related also to ''force sense'' and ''force sight'' was [[Precognition/Legends|''precognition'']], the ability to hear direction and whispered promptings from the Force about what lay ahead in the immediate future.

==Applications==
{{Quote|I sense something, a presence I've not felt since&hellip;|Darth Vader|<ref name="ANH" />}}
The ability to heighten the senses with the Force was usually one of the first things taught to a Jedi when they begin their [[Jedi training/Legends|training]]. A Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|student]] would learn how the Force binds all living things together, and learns to recognize these bonds and how they interact. This enables them to feel their environment, detect danger and the location of hidden beings or enemies even through barriers, as well as see in complete darkness.<ref name="EGtF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> However, as stated by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]], a Force user's ability to sense through the Force was never fully under their control.<ref name="SOI">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref>

[[File:Force_Sense.jpg|thumb|left|A Jedi could use the Force to sense the approach of an enemy.]]
Jedi and other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] would use this ability to sense impending danger, allowing the Force to warn them of a threat. This ability to sense danger would often come naturally to Force-sensitives and allowed the user to escape a potentially deadly situation, as when [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] thwarted the attempt on his life at the hands of his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> This danger sense was often described as tingling feeling in the back of the mind that foretold danger,<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref><ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> though it was known only to warn a Jedi of danger and wouldn't provide any information as to where the danger would come from.<ref name="SotP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> The danger sense would usually flare up just before an attack or some other threat occurred, giving the Force-user time to react to the danger.<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

Jedi could sense the location of hidden beings or enemies from a distance, and through barriers, allowing them to find, engage or avoid a being. Advanced users of this ability, such as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]] and his apprentice [[Jaden Korr]], were even able to sense the health of a nearby being.<ref name="JKJA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>

When many beings [[Death/Legends|died]], Jedi would often feel their deaths through the Force, such as after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sensed a "great [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]]".<ref name="ANH" /> This was also seen during the initial execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], when [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] Yoda felt the deaths of thousands of Jedi across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="RotS" /> Great disturbances, such as planets being destroyed, were able to be sensed from anywhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SECR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Jedi were also able to sense when a close friend or relative was in mortal danger or great pain from great distances, sometimes as much as from 10,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] away.<ref name="SECR" /> [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] sensed the impending danger of his love, [[Tahl]], from a great distance and even saw some of her situation. This ability was closely related to the more advanced technique of [[Farsight/Legends|farsight]] which usually came naturally as a Jedi's ability progressed. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was known to have developed this ability while training with Yoda on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], when he gained a brief glimpse of his friends in pain on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

===Clear mind===
Some Force-users had the ability to conceal themselves from other Force-users who might be trying to sense them with the Force. This ability was called "'''clear mind'''." Some [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinels]] had this ability, which would help them avoid detection in their covert missions to hunt down [[darksider]]s.<ref name="SECR" />
